Series A.name: Series A Funding V2 - AI Generated

Series B.name: Series B Funding V2 - AI Generated

fit_hot: B2B software selling to enterprise or regulated buyers: fintech, healthtech software, HR/payroll, security, data/AI infrastructure, insurtech, legaltech, govtech
fit_strong: Other B2B SaaS / AI / devtools / vertical software selling to businesses
fit_medium: B2B companies with a software component that will still face customer security reviews: marketplaces, tech-enabled services, B2B hardware with a cloud/data platform, edtech selling to schools or companies
fit_exclude: Biotech, therapeutics, drug discovery, medical devices, pure hardware with no software platform, energy/climate hardware, consumer apps, consumer goods, restaurants, real estate funds, crypto tokens, VC funds, services/agencies with no product
